description_en: Queries the number of servers to which an application whitelist policy is applied
description_zh: 查询应用白名单策略生效服务器数量
name: DescribeWhiteListStrategyUuidCount

parameters.help_en: The source IP address of the request. You do not need to specify this parameter because the system automatically retrieves the value
parameters.help_zh: 请求源IP。无需填写，系统自动获取
parameters.name: source_ip

parameters.help_en:
Specifies the language of the request and response. Default value: zh. Valid values:
zh: Chinese
en: English
parameters.help_zh:
设置请求和接收消息的语言类型。默认值为zh。取值：
zh：中文
en：英文
parameters.name: lang

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the policy.
You can call the [DescribeWhiteListStrategyStatistics](~~DescribeWhiteListStrategyStatistics~~) operation to query the value of this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
策略编号。
调用[DescribeWhiteListStrategyStatistics](~~DescribeWhiteListStrategyStatistics~~)接口可以获取该参数
parameters.name: strategy_id

parameters.help_en:
The type of the policy. Valid values:
1: learning policy
2: application policy
parameters.help_zh:
策略类型。
1：学习策略
2：应用策略
parameters.name: type

schema.description_en: The data returned in the response

RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用请求的ID，是由阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符，可用于排查和定位问题

UuidCount.description_en: The number of servers to which the application whitelist policy is applied
UuidCount.description_zh: 应用白名单策略生效服务器数量
